run_tiny_imagenet_handler: run the tiny_imagenet_handler function to process a Tiny ImageNet ZIP dataset and return metadata and split generators
create_downloadable_dataset: create a DownloadableDataset instance for Tiny ImageNet with download URLs and the handler function
extract_training_labels: extract training labels from Tiny ImageNet filenames using the label_to_id mapping
extract_test_labels: extract test labels from Tiny ImageNet validation annotations using the annotation to label mapping
generate_image_splits: generate train and test image generators from a Tiny ImageNet ZIP file with RGB conversion
